description: Prove the user owns a website so Xaminat can run the full inspection, including security checks and leaked-key details, and give a shareable "passed these checks" link. Call with action "start" to get a code and three ways to publish it (meta tag, file or DNS record), help the user publish it, then call with action "check". Needs a licence key.
name: verify_site
title: Verify site ownership
